# 🚀 GitHub Project Specification: Ta3allam LMS Roadmap

## Project Metadata
- **Project Title**: `Ta3 LMS Product Roadmap & Sprints`
- **Owner**: `ta3allam`
- **Target Repository**: `ta3allam/ta3`
- **Documentation Lead**: 🎯 **POAI (Product Owner AI)** — Assigned to keep all `.md` files in `.github/` updated whenever sprint or architectural changes occur.

## Description
> **Ta3 (تعلّم)** is an Arabic-first, high-aesthetic, enterprise-grade Learning Management System (LMS) built with React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and Docker. 
> This project orchestrates Sprint 1 (Foundation & UI), Sprint 2 (Supabase, Storage, Realtime, CQRS & Idempotency), and Sprint 3 (Production Docker & Cloud Readiness), delegating engineering tasks across specialized agent personas (**Fai**, **BAI**, **SAI**, **QAI**, **AAI**, **UXAI**, **ROAI**, **GAI**, **POAI**).

---

## Views & Fields Configuration
1. **Board View (Kanban)**:
   - Columns: `📋 Backlog` | `🚧 In Progress` | `🔍 In Review` | `✅ Done`
2. **Iteration View (Sprints)**:
   - **Sprint 1**: Foundation, Auth & Base UI Architecture (Days 1–5)
   - **Sprint 2**: Supabase Engine, CQRS & Resiliency (Days 6–13)
   - **Sprint 3**: Dockerization, Hardening & Production Cloud Readiness (Days 14–15)
3. **Roadmap View**:
   - Timeline visualization grouped by Milestone & Domain Label (`frontend`, `backend`, `cqrs`, `security`, `qa`, `architecture`, `ux`).
